uutiset.t: China Probes Politburo Member and Shanghai Chief Chen Jining
uutiset.s: China has placed Shanghai Communist Party chief Chen Jining, a member of the country’s elite Politburo, under investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.

uutiset.t: Huang’s Return Hits the Reset Button for AI Bets
uutiset.s: Jensen Huang is back at the center of the AI trade.

uutiset.t: Nvidia Market Whiplash Far From Over, Says RBC’s Wu Silverman
uutiset.s: Amy Wu Silverman, head of derivatives strategy at RBC Capital Markets, sees the VIX as “still pretty inflated” following the surge in Nvidia shares with the return of Jensen Huang as CEO. She speaks on “Bloomberg Brief.” (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Anthropic Breaks Below $83 IPO Price in Premarket Trading
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC shares traded below the $83 IPO price in premarket trading, wiping out gains for investors who piled into the artificial intelligence lab’s record-setting debut.

uutiset.t: Forced Buying Aided Biggest Rally Since April 2025, Nomura Says
uutiset.s: Wall Street roared back with its biggest rally since April 2025 on Monday, though analysis of the move suggests mechanical buying helped add momentum to the advance.

uutiset.t: Grocery Prices Are on the Rise, Just in Time for Thanksgiving
uutiset.s: Americans are finally getting some relief at the gas pump, but a surge in food prices is only beginning — just in time for holiday meals. Mark Niquette explains (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Lemssouguer’s Big Unwind Offers Glimpse Into Complex Credit Bets
uutiset.s: Hamza Lemssouguer became one of Europe’s most successful credit traders by making big bets on the region’s riskiest borrowers, often through complex derivatives that can deliver outsized gains.

uutiset.t: LME Speeds Up Procedure for Listing Metal From New Plants
uutiset.s: The London Metal Exchange will speed up its procedure for allowing delivery of metal from new producers, it said in a statement.

uutiset.t: Commerzbank Considers Partial Treasury Market Pullback
uutiset.s: Commerzbank is reportedly weighing whether to pare back its involvement in US Treasury trading. The German bank is weighing options including an exit from the US repo market and partnering with a broker dealer on its broader involvement in trading cash as the US prepares to introduce new Treasury cl

uutiset.t: Actuate to Invest $327 million in Spain’s Largest Battery Deal
uutiset.s: Actuate Energy, a clean-energy story firm backed by private equity NGP Energy Capital Management LLC, and Sungrow Renewables are set to develop the largest renewable energy storage portfolio in Spain.

uutiset.t: Colleges Rejecting Fossil Fuel Divestment Enjoy a Rich Payoff
uutiset.s: For years, campus and environmental activists concerned about climate change have pressured colleges to divest from fossil fuel companies. But those that hung tight are now glad they did. Bloomberg’s Janet Lorin explains. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Pimco’s Ivascyn Says AI Disruption Risk Boosts Appeal of Bonds
uutiset.s: The artificial intelligence boom is making the US economy more prone to disruption and market volatility, strengthening the case for Treasuries and other high-quality bonds, according to Pacific Investment Management Co.’s Daniel Ivascyn.

uutiset.t: LME to List New Aluminum Brand as Historic Squeeze Deepens
uutiset.s: The London Metal Exchange is preparing to authorize deliveries of aluminum from a major new smelter in Indonesia into its warehousing network, offering potential supply relief as a historic squeeze roils the global market.

uutiset.t: Xi Delays US Chip Retaliation After Trump Seals Nvidia U-Turn
uutiset.s: China extended the suspension of a ban on exports of several critical minerals to the US, holding back a potential response to Washington’s latest chip curbs hours after President Donald Trump helped restore Jensen Huang to the helm of Nvidia Corp.

uutiset.t: Compass Plans New York Main Listing, Adding to London Exodus
uutiset.s: British catering firm Compass Group Plc plans to move its primary listing from London to New York, adding to the struggles of the UK stock market.
